A.evidence: They checked the schedule again and realized only two robotics sessions were available, so not all three groups could take robotics.
A.evidenceJp: 日程を再確認するとロボット教室は二回しかなく、三班すべてが参加することはできないと分かりました。
A.reason: The key constraint was the mismatch between three groups and only two robotics opportunities.

A.answer: Each group had eighteen students, so B and C together made thirty-six, exactly the planetarium capacity.
A.evidence: Group A could attend robotics at 10:20 while Groups B and C watched the 10:30 planetarium show together.

A.prompt: Why did the final plan give the interactive lab to Group C instead of robotics?
A.answer: Because only two robotics sessions were available for three groups, and the lab offered a hands-on activity that fit Group C.
A.evidence: The final plan gave robotics to Groups A and B and the planetarium to all students in two rotations, while Group C used an interactive lab instead of robotics.
A.evidenceJp: 最終的にA班とB班がロボット教室を利用し、プラネタリウムは二回に分けて全員が見るようにし、C班はロボットの代わりに体験実験室を使う計画にしました。
A.reason: The alternative activity solved the capacity conflict without forcing an impossible third robotics session.

A.prompt: What did the teacher require when checking movement between rooms?
A.answer: A ten-minute movement margin, so groups were not scheduled in distant places back-to-back.
A.evidence: The teacher checked walking time between rooms and required a ten-minute movement margin, so no group was scheduled in two distant places back-to-back.
A.evidenceJp: 先生は部屋間の移動時間も確認し、10分の移動余裕を必ず取るようにしたため、離れた場所を連続して予定する班はありません。
A.reason: Travel time was treated as a real scheduling constraint, not ignored between activities.

A.prompt: Why was it reasonable for Group C to accept missing robotics?
A.answer: The alternative lab provided a similar hands-on activity, while forcing all three groups into robotics would break the room-capacity rule.
A.evidence: Students accepted that Group C would not do robotics because trying to force all three groups into two workshops would violate the room capacity. Instead, the interactive lab gave that group a hands-on activity of similar length.
A.evidenceJp: 二回しかないロボット教室へ三班すべてを無理に入れると定員違反になるため、C班が参加しないことを受け入れました。その代わり、同程度の時間の体験実験を行います。
A.reason: The final choice balanced fairness with the center's actual limits instead of pretending every activity could fit everyone.

B.prompt: What planning principle does the passage emphasize?
B.answer: A good group schedule must respect real limits such as capacity, time, and movement rather than forcing every group into every activity.
B.evidence: The class chose a plan that respected capacities and accepted that every group could not do every activity.
B.evidenceJp: 定員と時刻を守り、全班がすべての活動をできるわけではないことを受け入れた計画です。
B.reason: The final plan succeeds by working within constraints instead of ignoring them.
